scheme_name: Education Loan for Persons with Disabilities- Haryana
description:
The Education Loan for Persons with Disabilities scheme in Haryana was launched in 2015. 

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to persons with disabilities for pursuing higher education. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to empower individuals with disabilities by facilitating access to quality education. 

The scheme specifically targets students with disabilities who wish to pursue undergraduate and postgraduate courses. 

The financial assistance under this scheme can cover tuition fees, accommodation costs, and other educational expenses. 

The maximum loan amount available under this scheme is ₹10 lakhs. 

The interest rate on the loan is set at a subsidized rate of 4 percent per annum. 

This interest subsidy is provided to ensure that the financial burden on the beneficiaries is minimized. 

The repayment period for the loan is typically 10 years. 

However, there is a moratorium period of 1 year after the completion of the course before the repayment begins. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Haryana. 

Eligible applicants must have a disability certificate issued by a competent authority. 

The disability must be at least 40 percent as per the guidelines of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016. 

Applicants must be residents of Haryana to qualify for this scheme. 

The age limit for applicants is set at a minimum of 18 years. 

There is no upper age limit specified for applying under this scheme. 

The income criteria for eligibility state that the family income should not exceed ₹6 lakhs per annum. 

This income limit is aimed at ensuring that the benefits reach those who are economically weaker. 

To apply for the loan, candidates must fill out the prescribed application form available on the official website. 

The application form must be submitted along with a disability certificate. 

Additionally, applicants must provide proof of admission to a recognized educational institution. 

Documents required include income proof, identity proof, and address proof. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The loan amount will be sanctioned based on the eligibility criteria and the financial need of the applicant. 

Disbursement of the loan amount is typically done in installments. 

The first installment is released after the verification of documents and admission confirmation. 

Subsequent installments are released based on the academic calendar of the educational institution. 

The scheme also includes provisions for the renewal of the loan for subsequent years of study. 

Beneficiaries are encouraged to maintain regular communication with the implementing authorities. 

This ensures that any issues regarding loan disbursement or repayment can be addressed promptly. 

The Department of Social Justice and Empowerment can be contacted for any queries related to the scheme. 

Their official contact number is 1800 180 2020. 

The scheme has been instrumental in increasing the enrollment of persons with disabilities in higher education. 

According to reports, the enrollment rate of students with disabilities in Haryana has increased by 25 percent since the launch of this scheme. 

The financial assistance provided has enabled many students to pursue courses in engineering, medicine, and other professional fields. 

The scheme also aims to promote inclusivity in education by providing equal opportunities for persons with disabilities. 

In 2022, the government allocated ₹5 crores specifically for this scheme. 

This allocation is aimed at expanding the reach of the scheme and increasing the number of beneficiaries. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Haryana government to promote the welfare of persons with disabilities. 

Other initiatives include skill development programs and vocational training schemes. 

The Education Loan for Persons with Disabilities scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries. 

Many students have reported that the financial assistance has relieved their families of the burden of educational expenses. 

The scheme has also been praised for its low-interest rates compared to traditional education loans. 

The government encourages educational institutions to facilitate the process for students applying under this scheme. 

Institutions are urged to provide necessary documentation and support to applicants. 

The scheme is a significant step towards achieving the goals of the National Policy for Persons with Disabilities. 

This policy aims to create an inclusive society that provides equal opportunities for all. 

The Haryana government continues to monitor and evaluate the scheme to ensure its effectiveness. 

Regular assessments are conducted to identify areas for improvement and to enhance the benefits provided. 

The scheme is expected to evolve with changing educational needs and economic conditions. 

Overall, the Education Loan for Persons with Disabilities scheme in Haryana represents a commitment to supporting individuals with disabilities in their pursuit of higher education. 

It provides a structured and supportive framework for financial assistance, ensuring that education is accessible to all. 

This initiative is crucial for fostering independence and self-sufficiency among persons with disabilities. 

The scheme not only addresses financial barriers but also promotes social inclusion through education. 

As of October 2023, the scheme remains active and continues to accept applications from eligible candidates. 

The government encourages eligible individuals to take advantage of this opportunity for educational advancement. 

The scheme exemplifies the government's dedication to creating a more equitable society. 

By investing in the education of persons with disabilities, the Haryana government is paving the way for a brighter future for all. 

This initiative is a testament to the belief that education is a fundamental right that should be accessible to everyone.
